description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Dehigolla, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No.710024 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for various parcels in specific locations.
